records.name: Conversion Recipes
display_lines: Reagent | Reagent | Reagent | Output
9 Magic Jewels = Rare Jewel
6 Rare Jewels = Unique Jewel
Uber Spirits (1 of each) = Hellfire Torch

Stacked Rune (Qty ≥ 2) + TP Tome * = 1 Rune Higher Stack Qty - 2

Stacked Rune (Qty ≥ 1) + ID Tome * = 1 Rune Lower Stack Qty - 1
Healing Potion / (Any) + Gem (Any) = Rejuvenation Potion
3 Rejuvenation Potions = Full Rejuvenation Potion
Healing Potion / (Any) + 3 Gems (Any) = Full Rejuvenation Potion

Armor / Weapon / Shield / (Any) + Unique Jewel + OHM Rune = Ethereal Item
^ Does not work on Indestructible Items, Bows or Crossbows, or items without durability.
Armor / Weapon / Shield / (Any) + EL Rune + HEL Rune = White Base Item
^ Item is completely regenerated, as if a new white base dropped.

^ This recipe accepts any rarity. / Item is completely regenerated as a white item( no previous stats are retained) , upgraded to or remains Elite, and can gain superior modifiers in addition to the granted modifiers. / This recipe no longer stacks on items.
* Tome is returned full

• Battlemaiden (L)
• Hephasto (H)
• Frozenstein (H)

These are special monsters that guard various bosses throughout the game. They are listed by name followed by the boss they currently guard.

• The Smith's Arsenal - Smith
• Tormented Sister - Andariel
• Council in Durance of Hate Level 3 - Mephisto
• Legion and Leviathan - Izual
• Hephasto's Arsenal & Kudaai - Hephasto

SPECIAL UNIQUES
These are super uniques with their own loot tables.
• Blood Raven
• Griswold
• Smith
• Radamant
• Act 3 Council Members (Gold Name Only)
• Izual
• Cow King
SUPER UNIQUES & UNIQUES

Super uniques are named bosses that always appear in a certain map and / or location, such as A1 Stony Field's Rakanishu or Act 5 Frigid Highlands Rectifier. They have gold names and a set property or two in addition to random properties.
Uniques are randomly generated leaders of a pack of minions that spawn in an area as you explore it. They have gold names and random properties.
CHAMPIONS
A group of three monsters that spawn in an area as you explore it that have blue names.
